svg.title: Drishyam system architecture
svg.desc: Clients (browser UI, drishyam CLI, MCP client) reach one agent core: the browser through CloudFront with OAC and WAF, a Lambda Function URL and an arm64 Lambda running the FastAPI web tier (deployed; v1, the dacl10k-trained segmenter, runs live since 2026-10-21), with the static site in a private S3 bucket behind the same distribution; the CLI and MCP server run it locally. The agent core (policy, governor, planner with allow-list validator, human gate) drives the OpenCV 5 layer and emits an NDJSON trace and a signed work order. DynamoDB holds the kill flag, Secrets Manager the signing key, CloudWatch the metrics and alarms, X-Ray the traces, AWS Budgets the spend alerts; alarms and budget alerts reach the owner's email through SNS.
